title: $L^p$-Hodge decomposition and global integral estimates on the Cartan group
summary: The study of Sobolev and Poincaré inequalities for differential forms in Carnot groups and in the more general sub-Riemannian setting is still an open problem in its full generality. One may conjecture that, for general Carnot groups, these inequalities are expressed in terms of suitable graded Lebesgue norms. In recent years, many results have been obtained, both in the Euclidean setting and in the Heisenberg groups, as well as for contact manifolds with bounded geometry. There are also some results for general Carnot groups; however, these do not cover the problem in its full generality.…
